analysis:
This batch contains only changelog fragments and one architecture doc. No Swift source was supplied, so every claim below is a documentation statement, not verified behavior.

Weight verification (changelog.d/glm-startup-single-verification.md:3-4). This is the item most relevant to T-012, T-027, A-004 and T-041's verified-weightHash binding.
- The GLM managed load's per-file SHA-256 now becomes the published weight hash.
- A coordinator-mode restart can register the last verified hash from `~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json`. Reuse is gated on dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime.
- That record is owner-only, which means it is writable by the operator (ADV-001).
- If the load still verifies every manifest file before serving, as line 3 claims, editing the record cannot make substituted weights serve.
- Integration must confirm three things: (1) the registered hash cannot be published before load-time verification; (2) whether the record is integrity-protected; (3) whether the T-041 SSD cache weightHash binding can be satisfied by an unverified record. The threat model's A-004 and T-012 notes may need updating.

Memory accounting (page-cache-counts-as-available-memory.md:3-5; hardware-support.md head 256-262).
- `systemAvailable` becomes max(free+inactive, free−speculative+external+purgeable), so it is never stricter than before.
- The effect is on availability only (T-016, T-029). There is no confidentiality impact.
- Integration should check that SystemMemory.availableBytes excludes anonymous and compressed pages, as documented.

GLM wired-limit guidance (glm-wired-limit-notice.md; hardware-support.md head 226-234). This is advisory only, and the doc says no sudo is executed. Confirm that GLM5NextWiredLimit.swift does not spawn privileged commands; this is relevant to TB-010-style privilege concerns.

Output controls (native-engine-output-control-refusal.md; structured-output changelog).
- New typed 400 refusals reduce a consumer-triggered fleet cool-down DoS (ADV-002).
- Structured output and forced tool choice withhold content until it is validated.
- GLM logprobs adds a new output surface, but logprobs reveal only the requesting consumer's own distribution.

Reasoning and video changes (OpenRouter returned-reasoning, VFR video). These are request-parsing changes. Integration should verify the actual parsers' bounds for media (T-050) and for reasoning_details.

Why no findings: no concrete regression is provable from the supplied text.
